name: Hybrid Memory Constrained Isosurface Extraction
aliases: Optimal hybrid memory constrained cell extraction
definition: A method that optimally adapts to any given amount of available memory by combining multiple search methods (enumeration, octree, kd-tree, interval tree, out-of-core) within a binary spatial subdivision tree to minimize expected extraction time under a memory constraint.
summary: Hybrid Memory Constrained Isosurface Extraction generates isosurfaces within a strict memory limit by using Lagrangian optimization to assign the best extraction method to each spatial block, minimizing extraction time while ensuring topological consistency.
